title: Pieter Levels' story as told by Vaibhav Sisinty: from 12 startups to Photo AI and Fly
summary: Vaibhav Sisinty narrates Pieter Levels's path from a depressed traveler to a solo builder, covering Nomad List, Avatar AI, Photo AI and the flight game. Levels is heard only in two short clips, so the lessons here are the narrator's interpretation, not Levels's own words.
